about_the_game:
Kill the Skeletons – Embrace the Chaos!

Are you ready to fight the undead? Kill the Skeletons is a 3D clicker battle where thousands of creatures fly across the battlefield, and hundreds of weapons unleash pure destruction!

  • Tap to Attack, Obliterate the Horde!
    Your reflexes and weapons are your greatest tools. Click to destroy waves of skeletons, buy more weapons and enjoy the chaos!

  • Thousands of Skeletons, Increasingly Tougher Star Levels!

  • Hunt down thousands of skeletons and take on tougher star-level skeletons that are harder to kill but reward you with tons of gold! Grow your fortune and become unstoppable!

  • Over 10 Unique Weapons
    From swords and magic casters to laser runes and giant mortars, each weapon has its own mechanics and stunning visual effects!

  • Unlimited Upgrades
    There’s no limit to your power! Upgrade your weapons and combine them for greater star level weapons to take on even larger enemy swarms!

  • Mini-Games & Permanent Upgrades!
    The fun never stops! Play mini-games to earn rewards and unlock permanent upgrades for an even stronger start each time!

  • Three Different Currencies, Three Unique Strategies
    Each currency has its own mechanics and upgrade paths, allowing you to customize your playstyle and maximize your power.

💀💀💀
The skeleton war is about to begin! Grab your weapons, control the chaos, and dominate the battlefield! 
💀💀💀

name: Kill The Skeletons

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Mid-range CPU (Intel i3 8th Gen / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or higher)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD equivalent (DirectX 12 support required)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, These requirements are set to ensure a smooth gaming experience. If you encounter performance issues, lowering the graphics settings may help improve performance.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 10th Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super or AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended, These requirements are set to ensure a smooth gaming experience. If you encounter performance issues, lowering the graphics settings may help improve performance.

short_description: Kill the Skeletons is a unique real-time 3D clicker game where you can fully observe the battlefield as chaos unfolds. Watch thousands of creatures and hundreds of weapons in action while strategically clicking to defeat the skeleton horde.
